sentences.text:
Case :- Writ - C No. - 9496 of 2024
Petitioner :- Kamlesh And 4 Others
Respondent :- State Of U.P. Thru. Addl. Chief Prin. Secy. Deptt. Revenue Lko.

And 3 Othe
Counsel for Petitioner :- Saroj Kumar Shukla,Shailendra Kumar Misra

Counsel for Respondent :- C.S.C.,Ratnesh Chandra
Hon'ble Rajan Roy,J.
Hon'ble Brij Raj Singh,J.
Heard.

By means of present petition, petitioners seeks the following relief:-
"A writ, order or direction in the nature of Mandamus commanding the opposite parties particularly to opposite party no. 3 to pay 15 percent statutory interest per annum as per the provisions of section 34 of Land Acquisition Act 1894 to the Kamlesh And 4 Others vs State Of U.P. Thru. Addl. Chief Prin. ...

entities.text: Kamlesh And 4 Others vs State Of U.P. Thru. Addl. Chief
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
on 8 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/3093377/
1 petitioner on awarded compensation from the date of compulsory award till actual date of payment of compensation i.e. 21-10-2008 to 25-10-2023."

This relief can be considered by the Special Land Acquisition Officer, who has declared the award unless there is any legal impediment in this regard in which case he shall inform the petitioners in writing about the impediment.
However, if there is no legal impediment, he shall consider the aforesaid prayer and take such decision as may be required in law within a period of three months.

(Brij Raj Singh, J.) (Rajan Roy,J.) Order Date :- 8.11.2024 dk/
